controlChangeCommands.name: EXP 1
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Emulates EXP 1 pedal. Global reserved CC; cannot be used for Controller Assign.

controlChangeCommands.name: EXP 2
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Emulates EXP 2 pedal. Global reserved CC; cannot be used for Controller Assign.

controlChangeCommands.name: FS1
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Emulates FS1 in Stomp, Preset, or Snapshot footswitch mode. CC49-53 are global reserved.

controlChangeCommands.name: FS2
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Emulates FS2 in Stomp, Preset, or Snapshot footswitch mode.

controlChangeCommands.name: FS3
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Emulates FS3 in Stomp, Preset, or Snapshot footswitch mode.

controlChangeCommands.name: FS4
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Emulates FS4 (external via EXP/FS jack Tip when set to FS4).

controlChangeCommands.name: FS5
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Emulates FS5 (external via EXP/FS jack Ring when set to FS5).

controlChangeCommands.name: Looper Rec
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 1 Switch Looper Record/Overdub. Requires a Looper block in the preset.

controlChangeCommands.name: Looper Play
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 1 Switch Looper Play/Stop. Requires a Looper block in the preset.

controlChangeCommands.name: Play Once
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 1 Switch Looper Play Once. Values 64-127.

controlChangeCommands.name: Undo/Redo
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 1 Switch Looper Undo/Redo. Values 64-127.

controlChangeCommands.name: Tap Tempo
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Tap tempo. Values 64-127.

controlChangeCommands.name: Fwd/Rev
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 1 Switch Looper Forward/Reverse.

controlChangeCommands.name: Full/Half
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 1 Switch Looper Full/Half Speed.

controlChangeCommands.name: Tuner
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Tuner screen on/off. Manual lists 0-127 without band thresholds; Off/On use extremes.

controlChangeCommands.name: Snapshot
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Snapshot select. Body text documents 3 snapshots per preset; MIDI CC appendix lists value 3=Snapshot 4. CC69 during preset load is buffered until PC finishes. Bank MSB/LSB (CC0/32) reserved unused. Per-block bypass/parameter CCs are user-assigned (Learn), not fixed factory CCs.

controlChangeCommands.name: All Bypass
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0-63 Bypass, 64-127 On (engage processing).

controlChangeCommands.name: Mode Switch
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Engages the MODE switch (cycles footswitch mode). Any value.

controlChangeCommands.name: Preset Nav
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0-63 previous preset, 64-127 next preset.

controlChangeCommands.name: Play/Edit
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Toggles between Play and Edit views. Any value.

controlChangeCommands.name: Param Knob 1
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Parameter Knob 1 global control.

controlChangeCommands.name: Param Knob 2
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Parameter Knob 2 global control.

controlChangeCommands.name: Param Knob 3
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Parameter Knob 3 global control.

controlChangeCommands.name: Page L/R
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0-63 Page Left, 64-127 Page Right.
